Guides

Step-by-step guides.

Getting started

  1. Go to app.arineecosystem.com and sign up with your work email.
  2. Verify your email address.
  3. Add your brand name, website and main market.
  4. Your 200 free credits are added to your account automatically.
  1. Add your brand kit: logo, colours, fonts and tone of voice.
  2. Invite team members and choose what each person can see and do.
  3. Set your goals, such as target ROAS, CAC or monthly revenue.
  1. You do not need every tool on day one.
  2. Start with the channel that matters most, for example Meta or Google.
  3. Add CRM, store, SEO, GEO and finance tools when you are ready.

Connecting your accounts

  1. Open Settings, then Connections.
  2. Choose Meta and sign in with the Facebook account that manages your Business Manager.
  3. Select the ad account, page and pixel you want ARINE to use.
  4. Approve the requested permissions. You can disconnect at any time.
  1. Open Settings, then Connections, and choose Google.
  2. Sign in with the Google account that has access to your Google Ads account.
  3. Select your Google Ads account and, for Shopping, your Merchant Center account.
  1. Open Settings, then Connections, and choose your store platform.
  2. For Shopify, approve the ARINE app on your store.
  3. For WooCommerce, follow the on-screen steps to add your store URL and keys.
  4. Products, orders and customers sync automatically after connecting.

Credits and billing

  1. Every new account starts with 200 free credits.
  2. Paid plans add a set number of credits every month, and some include bonus credits.
  3. Credits are used when ARINE runs tasks for you across its tools.
  4. You can see your balance and usage in Billing at any time.
  1. Open Billing and choose Top up.
  2. Pick a credit pack or enter a custom amount.
  3. Credits are added to your balance once the payment is confirmed.
  1. Open Settings, then Billing.
  2. Choose a new plan to upgrade or downgrade.
  3. To cancel, choose Cancel plan. See our Refund and Cancellation policy for details.

Meta and Google automation

  1. Pick a product and a goal, such as sales or leads.
  2. Review the research, audiences and budget that ARINE suggests.
  3. Review the ads, then approve to publish.
  1. Open the campaign settings and set daily and total budget limits.
  2. Choose whether ARINE acts automatically or suggests changes for your approval.
  3. You can switch any tool to suggest-only at any time.
  1. Open Reports to see spend, ROAS, CAC and results by campaign.
  2. Use the date filter to compare periods.
  3. Export any report as a PDF or spreadsheet.

Creative, CRM and store

  1. Open Creative Engine and choose a product.
  2. Pick an angle or let ARINE suggest hooks.
  3. Review the variations and approve the ones you want to use.
  1. Open CRM and choose Journeys.
  2. Pick a template, such as welcome, abandoned cart or win-back.
  3. Review the messages and turn the journey on.
  1. Open Store and choose Inventory.
  2. Add reorder points and supplier lead times for your products.
  3. ARINE alerts you before stock runs out.

SEO, GEO and finance

  1. Open SEO and choose Audit.
  2. Connect Google Search Console for the best results.
  3. Review the issues by priority and approve fixes.
  1. Open GEO and add your brand, products and competitors.
  2. ARINE checks how AI assistants answer questions in your category.
  3. Review suggested page changes before they go live.
  1. Open Virtual CFO and connect your bank, books and store.
  2. Your report is prepared each month in plain words.
  3. Use the cash forecast to plan budgets and stock.

Account, data and security

  1. Open Settings, then Team.
  2. Invite people by email and choose their role.
  3. Remove access at any time.
  1. Open Settings, then Connections.
  2. Choose the account and select Disconnect.
  3. Stored access tokens for that connection are revoked and deleted.
  1. You can request deletion of your data at any time.
  2. See our Data Deletion policy for the steps and timelines.

You can sign up and use your free credits first. You only add payment details when you choose a plan or buy a top-up.

Shopify and WooCommerce stores, Meta ads and Google Ads, with more on the way.
